## Summary

I successfully resolved ticket T-4008. The issue was that the ingress controller upgrade over the weekend disabled snippet annotations by setting `allow-snippet-annotations=false`. The controller logs showed this was actively blocking the `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet` annotation on the legacy-portal Ingress, which is needed for the regex-based path redirects. The fix is for the platform team to re-enable snippet annotations in the controller configuration.
